method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridian labels and two engraved parallel labels were read directly, their rules were traced independently across the mapped area, and all eight crossings were measured on full-resolution crops. The automatic detector's linen-fold and frame candidates were discarded before the two corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 60d45mW, 60d40mW, 60d35mW and 60d30mW from west to east. The left labels read 46d55mN and 46d50mN from north to south. The retained crossings remain visible through geological colour, hatching, roads and hydrography. A prominent diagonal survey/geological rule, vertical linen folds, frame lines and shoreline strokes are visibly distinct in the contact sheet and were not used.
